answer.generator_derivation: At fixture construction, yes for the numerator but only from captured native values: build_fixture runs the native producer, profiles module.main return locals into value, and computes power1_numerator as module.spec(value[PHI], value[FIX] plus c7_8=1 and c8_10=1), then serializes the result in c8_11. The same captured value[PHI] is separately serialized as full_model.Phi_b0_compat.
answer.generator_denominator: No derivation of the denominator appears in the adapter: build_fixture serializes power1_denominator directly from captured value[sD]. The bounded adapter text does not derive sD from the full model, the Cramer matrix, or a persisted slice identity.
answer.frozen_validator: No independent derivation occurs during ordinary fixture validation. A6 recomputes the Cramer reconstruction of full Phi from the stored matrix/RHS/Lambda data. A7 then decodes the stored power1 numerator and denominator and only proves their univariate division remainder is nonzero. There is no check equating those fields to a specialization of full_model.Phi_b0_compat, to slice fields, to det5, or to a recomputed sD.
answer.custody: Before fixture creation B1 hashes native bindings and captures native output. Afterwards F4 binds the whole serialized fixture by SHA-256; optional B3/B4 rehash current native files. Those controls preserve byte/input identity, but neither recomputes the power-one pair from the retained fixture nor compares a fresh native capture to the serialized pair. Optional native_replay checks the native process return code and summary text only.
answer.mathematical_denominator_necessity: A7 proves the narrow supplied-polynomial statement D does not divide N in the decoded univariate ring. It does not, from this adapter alone, prove that D is the mathematically required specialized det5 denominator, that N/D is the relevant full-model specialization, or that a det5-square is wall-wide necessary. A6 establishes a different stored-data Cramer identity using det5 squared; the missing equality/link prevents combining A6 and A7 into a replayed wall-wide necessity theorem.

possible_neutral_case_scope.not_supported_now: Do not label that case full-model, Cramer-derived, det5-specific, wall-wide, or a proof that square clearing is mathematically necessary. The bounded adapter does not replay those provenance links.
possible_neutral_case_scope.existing_case_mapping: No current neutral case is an exact match for the supplied-power-one Cramer provenance distinction. GP-X119/X120 cover nonzero/nonunit versus nonzerodivisor and are not substitutes.
